en.headline:
Tarot data.
Your reading.
en.intro: Build card-driven apps with bilingual references, artwork and spread layouts. Connect over REST or MCP.
en.concept_title: The catalog is one part of a reading.
en.concept: Frankie returns structured card references and spread definitions. Your interface chooses the question, cards, upright or reversed orientation, interpretation and saved state.
features: Retrieve names, keywords, descriptions, upright and reversed meanings, three artwork URLs and source details. Stable IDs such as maj00 identify the same card across languages.
Each spread supplies its card count, ordered position labels and any per-position card pool. The Court spread, for example, asks for a pip card, a court card and a major arcana card.
The same data for an agent
Five UI-free MCP tools expose search, lookup, spread definitions and optional draws. The service does not call a language model or produce a personalized interpretation.
en.explorer_note: This small adaptation of the real SpreadLayout component uses the current source dataset. The numbered shapes are positions, not selected cards. Nothing is sent or saved.
en.request_note: A deterministic lookup is a useful first request. This abbreviated example uses real catalog fields; the live response also contains meanings, artwork URLs and provenance.
en.revision_note: Omitting revision keeps legacy spread semantics for existing clients. Request revision=pkt-1911-v1 for the current PKT-adapted definitions, including corrected Celtic Cross positions. Retain the returned definition with a reading rather than silently replacing its labels later.
steps: Fetch cards and spreads in en or zh-CN. The default locale is zh-CN; the catalog has no pagination. No service API key is required.
Keep manual choice in your app
Let the user select a spread and cards, then look up those IDs. The independent Frankie Tarot app provides the interactive table; this service provides its references.
Use automatic draws only by choice
The optional random-card and spread-draw endpoints create a new sample. Draw only after the user explicitly delegates that action. A reading topic alone does not choose cards for them.
Save card IDs, positions, orientation and the exact definition in the caller. There is no public seed, idempotency key or recovery endpoint; an uncertain retry is a new draw.
en.mcp_title: REST for apps. MCP for tools.
en.mcp: REST offers read-only GET endpoints with CORS. Agent MCP uses Streamable HTTP at /mcp/agent and returns structured content. It is a tool service, not a ChatGPT visual widget or an account system.
captions: The live reference, with original card artwork and request examples.
The real spread reference and numbered position layouts.
boundaries: Primary meanings carry cited PKT 1911 English passages and editorial Chinese summaries. modernMeanings preserves project-curated extensions; artistic variants, keywords and descriptions are also curated. Read provenance rather than assuming every field is a historical quotation.

The service has no database or model API dependency. Reading history, recovery, consent, interpretation and orientation belong to the caller. Symbolic meanings are not factual predictions or probabilities.
Invalid queries return 400, unknown cards or spreads return 404, and unsupported REST API methods return 405. Handle the error response rather than inventing a successful result.
en.run_note: REST and Agent MCP run at http://127.0.0.1:3001. The separate Vite command edits the full API reference; a static server alone does not run the service.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan
en.card_caption: The Fool, from the actual redraw artwork. This is a fixed catalog example, not a draw.

zh.headline:
塔罗数据，
解读由你决定。
zh.intro: 用双语牌义、原始牌图与牌阵布局构建应用，通过 REST 或 MCP 接入。
zh.concept_title: 牌库，是一次解读的其中一部分。
zh.concept: Frankie 返回结构化的牌面参考与牌阵定义。问题、选牌、正逆位、解读与保存状态，由调用方界面负责。
features: 获取名称、关键词、描述、正逆位牌义、三种牌图 URL 与来源信息。maj00 这样的稳定 ID，在不同语言中仍指向同一张牌。
每个牌阵提供牌数、有序位置标签与各位置的牌池。例如宫廷行为模式依次使用点数牌、宫廷牌与大阿卡纳。
智能体也使用相同数据
五个无 UI 的 MCP 工具提供检索、查询、牌阵定义与可选抽牌。服务本身不调用语言模型，也不生成个性化解读。
zh.explorer_note: 这个小示例改编自真实的 SpreadLayout 组件，使用当前源码数据。编号图形表示位置，并非已经选出的牌；不会发送请求或保存记录。
zh.positions: 按 API 顺序排列的位置
zh.request_note: 确定性的牌面查询适合作为第一条请求。这个节选示例使用真实牌库字段；完整响应还包括牌义、牌图 URL 与来源。
zh.revision_note: 省略 revision 时，服务沿用旧版牌阵语义，兼容已有调用方。指定 revision=pkt-1911-v1 可使用当前 PKT 改编定义，包括修正后的凯尔特十字位置。应随解读保存返回的定义，不要事后悄悄替换位置标签。
steps: 选择 en 或 zh-CN 获取牌库与牌阵，默认语言为 zh-CN。牌库不分页，公共服务无需 API key。
在应用中保留手动选择
让用户选择牌阵与牌，再按 ID 查询。独立的 Frankie Tarot 应用提供交互牌桌，这个服务提供参考数据。
明确选择后，再自动抽牌
可选的随机牌与牌阵抽牌接口，每次都会生成新样本。只有用户明确委托自动抽牌时才调用；只提出一个问题，并不等于同意代选卡牌。
调用方保存牌 ID、位置、正逆位与准确的牌阵定义。没有公开种子、幂等键或恢复接口；结果不确定时再次请求，会是新一次抽牌。
zh.mcp_title: 应用用 REST，工具用 MCP。
zh.mcp: REST 提供带 CORS 的只读 GET 接口。Agent MCP 通过 /mcp/agent 的 Streamable HTTP 返回结构化内容；它是工具服务，不是 ChatGPT 可视化组件或账号系统。
captions: 线上真实文档，包含原始牌图与请求示例。
真实的牌阵参考与编号位置布局。
boundaries: 主要牌义附有 PKT 1911 英文引文出处与中文编辑摘要。modernMeanings 保留项目整理的延伸解释，图像变体、关键词与描述同样经过项目编辑；不能把所有字段都视为历史原文。
没有隐藏的解读数据库
服务没有数据库或模型 API 依赖。历史、恢复、用户选择、解读与正逆位由调用方管理；象征性牌义不是事实预测或概率。
不合法查询返回 400，不存在的牌或牌阵返回 404，不支持的 REST 方法返回 405。应处理错误响应，不能编造成功结果。
zh.run_note: REST 与 Agent MCP 位于 http://127.0.0.1:3001。独立的 Vite 命令用于编辑完整文档；只启动静态文件服务器，并不会运行服务。
